subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------SPT.DYM.
description: Chart on book p. 448 (MP(I)-22). AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the subject; SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism), TR (transformation) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From RE-ST: SOC-RT (social reality). From TR: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PROG-CONT: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From SOC-RT: POL-DY (political dynamics). From ACC-DY: AFI (affinity insight) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From POL-DY: PART (participation).
